title: Hagelloch as in 1861, with one gathering: care sought at the hospital, nothing done to stop the spread

calendar.note: 30 October 1861, the first child's first symptoms, was a Wednesday. The school is taken to meet Monday to Saturday: assumed, since the 1861 school calendar is not in any open source found. The gathering's date is not in any source; 10 November stands in, and scripts/abm-hagelloch-fit.mjs --gathering fits it.

detection.label: A family seeks care for a child with the rash

source.citation: Pfeilsticker A. Beiträge zur Pathologie der Masern mit besonderer Berücksichtigung der statistischen Verhältnisse. Tübingen: Eberhard-Karls-Universität; 1863.

evidence.quote: wird meist die ärztliche Hilfe im Tübinger Krankenhaus gesucht (medical help is mostly sought at the Tübingen hospital)
evidence.note: The pathway is cited: news of the outbreak reached the hospital through care sought there. The daily chance is assumed. 0.02 a day for each child with the rash.
